groups.notes: These pages give no printed numeric value for late-adaptation pointing error in old subjects. The adaptation phase is shown only as a figure ("Fig. 1 Mean pointing errors of young (triangles) and old (squares) subjects before, during, and after exposure to rotated visual feedback... Also shown are the standard deviations"), plus ANOVA results (Age F(1,22)=7.58, P<0.05; Episode F(14,308)=41.14, P<0.001; interaction F(14,308)=3.44, P<0.001) and a fitted exponential equation: "An exponential fit yielded y=9.92+53.51×exp(−x/5.89) for young subjects and y=29.51+29.91×exp(−x/5.13) for old subjects." The fit equation's asymptote (29.51) would require computation/interpretation, so it is not transcribed as the reported value. The only text means±SD on these pages are ages and trail-making times (42.5±6.9 s for old), which are different outcomes.

No printed numeric late-adaptation pointing error for young subjects on these pages. Only Fig. 1 (mean pointing errors with standard deviations, values not printed in text), ANOVA statistics, and the exponential fit "y=9.92+53.51×exp(−x/5.89) for young subjects" are available; extracting an endpoint value would require computation or reading the chart.
